Manage installed macOS templates for fast VM creation.

```text
pomme template SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme template create

Restore a macOS image once so VMs can be cloned from it.

```text
pomme template create [FLAGS] NAME
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Template name. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--version VERSION` | macOS version, build, or `latest`. |
| `--latest` | Use the latest signed macOS version. Same as `--version latest`. |
| `--restore-image RESTORE_IMAGE` | Local IPSW path. |
| `--ipsw-device IPSW_DEVICE` | Apple silicon Mac identifier used to resolve `--version`. |
| `--disk-size DISK_SIZE` | Virtual disk size; every VM cloned from the template inherits it. Default: `60GB`. |
| `--memory MEMORY` | Guest memory used only while restoring the image. Default: `4GB`. |
| `--from-template FROM_TEMPLATE` | Build on an existing installed template instead of restoring an image again. Only with `--provisioned`. |
| `--provisioned` | Also prepare the owner account and leave SIP disabled with the AMFI override on, so a VM cloned from this template can run MDM enrollment as its first command with no security mutation. Every VM cloned from it inherits that posture. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme template list

List installed templates.

```text
pomme template list [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme template delete

Delete an installed template.

```text
pomme template delete NAME [--force] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Template name. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--force` | Delete without prompting. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
